title: Fixture Adobe Security Bulletin APSB99-01
raw_text: Adobe has released security updates for Magento. CVE-2026-10001 affects AccountManagement. CVE-2026-10002 affects Quote. Apply isolated patch or upgrade.

risk_items.title: Improper Authorization in AccountManagement
risk_items.business_impact: Authenticated admin actions may be forged without CSRF token.
